record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Quantum Information Theory
record.original_question: Is there a construction linking symmetric informationally complete POVMs to finite affine planes, analogous to constructions that relate finite geometries to mutually unbiased bases?

evidence.quote: Inspired by a construction that links finite geometries to MUBs, there have been some speculations by Wootters about whether SIC-POVMs can be linked to finite affine planes [7].
However, the existence of such a construction remains an open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A symmetric informationally complete positive-operator-valued measure (SIC-POVM) in dimension $d$ is a set of $d^2$ rank-one operators $\{\Pi_i = \tfrac{1}{d}|\psi_i\rangle\langle\psi_i|\}_{i=1}^{d^2}$ on $\mathbb{C}^d$ such that $\sum_{i=1}^{d^2} \Pi_i = I$ and 
$$|\langle \psi_i | \psi_j\rangle|^2 = \frac{1}{d+1} \quad \text{for all } i\neq j.$$
A finite affine plane of order $n$ is an incidence structure consisting of $n^2$ points and $n(n+1)$ lines, partitioned into $n+1$ parallel classes of $n$ lines each, such that every two distinct points lie on exactly one line and Playfair's parallel axiom holds.

It is known that a complete set of $d+1$ mutually unbiased bases in $\mathbb{C}^d$ (when $d$ is a prime power) can be obtained from a natural construction based on the finite affine plane of order $d$, and that SIC-POVMs and complete sets of mutually unbiased bases exhibit a point–line duality at the level of finite geometry.

Problem: Determine whether there exists a general construction that associates to each finite affine plane (equivalently, in each prime-power dimension $d$) a SIC-POVM in $\mathbb{C}^d$ in a manner analogous to the affine-plane construction of mutually unbiased bases. Either exhibit such a construction or prove that no such construction exists.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and resources on SIC-POVMs (including the SIC state-of-play survey and the Open Quantum Problems entry on SIC-POVMs and Zauner's conjecture) describe a known point–line duality between SIC-POVMs and mutually unbiased bases via finite affine planes, but no explicit general construction of SIC-POVMs from finite affine planes is known. The existence of such a construction remains open as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: The SIC Question: History and State of Play
status_evidence.snippet: SIC-POVMs and MUBs are dual at the level of finite geometry, but no general construction relating SIC-POVMs to finite affine planes is known.
status_evidence.claim: A general affine-plane construction for SIC-POVMs is not known.

status_evidence.title: SIC POVMs and Zauner's Conjecture – Open Quantum Problems
status_evidence.snippet: The general existence problem for SIC-POVMs in all dimensions remains open.
status_evidence.claim: SIC-POVM existence remains an open problem.
